purpose: Install and audit the mechanical brakes of a repository: agent-host hooks, repository controls and GitHub checks, for any language, stack, agent host and model provider.

commands.lint: git diff --check && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings

environment_notes: Rust 1.99+ and Cargo build the tool; its binary requires Git, with gh optional for doctor --remote.
No model calls and no target project commands during installation.
